title: Esculin Alleviates Osteoarthritis Progression Through the Sirt1/NF-kappaB Pathway.
authors: Sun, Tao; Bai, Bingli; Wu, Haohao; Xing, Hailin; Li, Jian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Esculin通过Sirt1/NF-kappaB通路缓解骨关节炎，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA), a joint disease associated with inflammatory processes, contributes to joint destruction. Esculin (ESC) extracted from the stem bark of Fraxinus rhynchophylla Hance has been shown to possess anti-inflammatory properties. In this study, we investigated the effect of ESC on chondrocytes treated with IL-1beta and its molecular mechanism. The importance and potential mechanism of ESC in the progression of OA were evaluated. The viability of chondrocytes after exposure to ESC was examined through the CCK-8 assays. The cells were then subjected to quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR), western blot, and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) techniques to analyze the degradation of the extracellular matrix (ECM) and occurrence of inflammation. The NF-kappaB mechanism was evaluated by western blot analysis, immunofluorescence (IF), and luciferase reporter assay. Molecular docking was performed to allow for predictions on proteins that interact with ESC. Moreover, the significance of Sirt1 was explored through a knockdown experiment based on siRNA. Micro-computed tomography (CT), H&E, Safranin O-Fast Green (S-O), and immunohistochemical analyses were carried out to assess the treatment efficacy of ESC on OA in destabilization of medial meniscus (DMM) models. ESC treatment effectively inhibited ECM degradation, modulated the levels of pro-inflammatory factors, and regulated the NF-kappaB signaling in chondrocytes exposed to IL-1beta. Mechanistically, we found that ESCs bound to Sirt1 to inhibit the activity of the NF-kappaB mechanism. Furthermore, ESC treatment suppressed OA progression in the DMM models. Our findings reveal that ESC ameliorates OA progression via modulating the Sirt1/NF-kappaB axis. This demonstrates that ESC has the potential to be applied in the treatment of OA.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种与炎症过程相关的关节疾病，导致关节破坏。从白蜡树（Fraxinus rhynchophylla Hance）茎皮中提取的秦皮乙素（Esculin, ESC）已被证明具有抗炎特性。在本研究中，我们探讨了ESC对经IL-1β处理的软骨细胞的影响及其分子机制，并评估了ESC在OA进展中的重要性及潜在机制。通过CCK-8实验检测ESC处理后软骨细胞的活力。随后，采用定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）、蛋白质印迹（western blot）和酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）技术分析细胞外基质（ECM）的降解及炎症的发生。通过蛋白质印迹分析、免疫荧光（IF）和荧光素酶报告基因实验评估NF-kappaB机制。进行分子对接以预测与ESC相互作用的蛋白质。此外，通过基于siRNA的敲低实验探讨了Sirt1的重要性。采用微型计算机断层扫描（CT）、H&E染色、番红O-固绿（S-O）染色和免疫组化分析，评估ESC在 destabilization of medial meniscus (DMM) 模型中对OA的治疗效果。ESC处理有效抑制了ECM降解，调节了促炎因子水平，并调控了暴露于IL-1β的软骨细胞中的NF-kappaB信号通路。机制上，我们发现ESC与Sirt1结合以抑制NF-kappaB机制的活性。此外，ESC处理在DMM模型中抑制了OA进展。我们的研究结果表明，ESC通过调节Sirt1/NF-kappaB轴改善OA进展，这证明ESC具有应用于OA治疗的潜力。
